eta_definition.runner_eta: progress.eta_seconds is remaining joint decisions divided by the measured average decisions/sec; it is to 1M only, excluding post-budget selection/final. If a checkpoint screen is active, it is the last training-loop estimate.
eta_definition.full_run_projection: Adds 21–25 recent-screen-duration equivalents: 3 final reports × 100 episodes plus 3–5 unique selection checkpoints × 40 episodes, divided by 20 episodes per screen. Estimate only; assumes comparable episode lengths and compute contention.

runs.interpretation: 相对 step 0 有少量 capture completion；best 到 last 略回落，碰撞仍高，信号偏弱且未稳定。
screen 峰值高于初始值，但到 last 回落且碰撞上升；表现为学习后退化/高波动。
representation 线有低幅 capture 信号，best 后回落且最近碰撞率高；目前没有稳定提升证据。
screen 在 550k 有较高峰值，700k 已归零且碰撞全覆盖；呈明显学习后退化信号。
last 略低于 screen 峰值，碰撞仍高；仅有小幅、波动的 task signal。
